mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, user_id AS userId, type_code AS typeCode, content AS content, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE' THEN 'system' WHEN type_code IN ('BOT_MESSAGE', 'CHAT_REMINDER') THEN 'mate' ELSE 'update' END AS type, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' AND LOCATE(CHAR(10), content) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(content, CHAR(10), 1)) WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' THEN '신고/문의 답변이 등록되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'POST_COMMENT' THEN '새 댓글이 달렸습니다' WHEN type_code = 'COMMENT_REPLY' THEN '대댓글이 달렸습니다' WHEN type_code = 'BOT_MESSAGE' THEN '메이티의 새 쪽지가 도착했습니다' WHEN type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE' THEN '공지사항이 있습니다' WHEN type_code = 'POINT_REWARD' THEN '포인트가 지급되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'COMMUNITY_HOT' THEN '내 글이 인기글이 되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'REPORT_RESULT' THEN '신고 처리 결과가 나왔습니다' WHEN type_code = 'CHAT_REMINDER' THEN '메이트가 기다리고 있어요' WHEN type_code = 'EVENT_NOTICE' THEN '새로운 이벤트가 시작되었습니다' ELSE '새로운 알림이 있습니다' END AS title, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' AND LOCATE(CHAR(10), content) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(content, LOCATE(CHAR(10), content) + 1)) ELSE content END AS message FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION n INNER JOIN ( SELECT z.notification_id FROM ( SELECT n2.notification_id FROM NOTIFICATION n2 WHERE n2.user_id = #{userId} AND n2.is_read = 0 ) z ) x ON x.notification_id = n.notification_id SET n.is_read = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (user_id, type_code, content, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{typeCode}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' AND target_type = 'SUPPORT' AND target_id = #{supportId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET content = #{content}, is_read = 0, created_at = NOW() WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER'

UPDATE NOTIFICATION n INNER JOIN ( SELECT z.notification_id FROM ( SELECT n2.notification_id FROM NOTIFICATION n2 INNER JOIN SUPPORT s ON s.support_id = n2.target_id AND s.user_id = n2.user_id WHERE n2.user_id = #{userId} AND n2.is_read = 0 AND n2.target_type = 'SUPPORT' AND n2.type_code IN ('SUPPORT_ANSWER', 'REPORT_RESULT') ) z ) x ON x.notification_id = n.notification_id SET n.is_read = 1

UPDATE NOTIFICATION n INNER JOIN ( SELECT z.notification_id FROM ( SELECT n2.notification_id FROM NOTIFICATION n2 WHERE n2.user_id = #{userId} AND n2.is_read = 0 AND ( (UPPER(COALESCE(n2.target_type, '')) = 'POST' AND n2.target_id = #{postId}) OR ( n2.type_code IN ('POST_COMMENT', 'COMMENT_REPLY', 'COMMUNITY_HOT') AND UPPER(COALESCE(n2.target_type, '')) = 'POST' AND n2.target_id = #{postId} ) OR ( n2.type_code IN ('POST_COMMENT', 'COMMENT_REPLY') AND UPPER(COALESCE(n2.target_type, '')) = 'COMMENT' AND n2.target_id IN ( SELECT c.comment_id FROM COMMENT c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ) ) OR ( n2.type_code IN ('SUPPORT_ANSWER', 'REPORT_RESULT') AND n2.target_type = 'SUPPORT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUPPORT s WHERE s.support_id = n2.target_id AND s.user_id = n2.user_id AND ( s.title = CONCAT('REPORT / POST / ', #{postId}) OR s.title LIKE CONCAT('[REPORT POST ', #{postId}, ']%') ) ) ) OR ( n2.type_code IN ('SUPPORT_ANSWER', 'REPORT_RESULT') AND n2.target_type = 'SUPPORT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUPPORT s INNER JOIN COMMENT c ON c.post_id = #{postId} WHERE s.support_id = n2.target_id AND s.user_id = n2.user_id AND ( s.title = CONCAT('REPORT / COMMENT / ', c.comment_id) OR s.title LIKE CONCAT('[REPORT COMMENT ', c.comment_id, ']%') ) ) ) ) ) z ) x ON x.notification_id = n.notification_id SET n.is_read = 1
